messages.plaintextBody:
Alice,

Quick one on the Quartz financing rather than Cedar — Ravensworth's accountants have raised a question on the completion accounts adjustment in the subscription agreement, specifically the working-capital true-up. Could Marcus's team confirm the December management figures so we can respond? I'll keep this separate from the Cedar correspondence.

Thanks,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
